record.title: Record RCV-0001
record.summary: $225,000 rice invoice to a buyer in the UAE, due 75 days after shipment. 90% of face paid at purchase; the balance, less the financier’s discount and charges, when the buyer pays.
record.description: Illustrative record of one export receivable: six documents filed; state 05 of 8, purchased.

documents.proves: What was sold, to whom, for how much and when it’s due, with the instruction to pay the financier
The goods were cleared for export, as invoiced
The goods were shipped on board

documents.source: The insurer, in the financier’s name
documents.proves: The buyer’s credit is covered, in the financier’s name
The buyer will pay the financier’s account
The financier bought the receivable, without recourse for the buyer’s credit

states.what: The exporter ships the rice and invoices the buyer, with the instruction to pay the financier’s account.
Shipping bill, invoice and bill of lading are checked against each other and filed in one evidence package.
The buyer’s limit with the insurer is checked; the cover is in the financier’s name.
The buyer acknowledges that it will pay the financier.
The financier buys the receivable, without recourse for the buyer’s credit.
states.money: The financier pays 90% of face to the exporter’s own bank

states.what: On the due date the buyer pays, and the exporter’s bank closes the shipping bill.
The outcome joins the record of how the asset performs.
On the venue, a receivable can move to another institutional financier, with a registry entry.
